marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to west 25 knots early Friday morning then
diminishing to light Friday evening. Scattered flurries and fog patches with a risk of freezing
drizzle changing to snow this afternoon. Visibility 1 mile or less in fog
patches and as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2
Friday morning.<br/>

marine.text:
